runner: make (poetry-backed); make binary absent on PATH in this Windows Git-Bash checkout, so gates ran via the exact underlying Makefile recipe commands

gates.command: poetry run ruff format && poetry run ruff check --fix && poetry run ruff check
gates.notes: Guide command is `make ruff`; `make` is not installed on this Windows machine (bash: make: command not found; where.exe found no match), so the three underlying recipe lines were run verbatim instead. `ruff format` reformatted tests/codemie/rest_api/a2a/test_version.py (the new Slice 1 test file); ruff check --fix and ruff check then passed clean with no remaining violations.
Guide command is `make build`; substituted the underlying `poetry build` recipe line for the same `make`-missing reason as lint. Built codemie-0.8.0 sdist and wheel successfully.

Guide command is `make test`; substituted the underlying `poetry run pytest tests/` recipe line. Could not complete: even `--collect-only` over the full tests/ tree (1121 files, 15481 collected tests, 2 xdist workers per pytest.ini `-n 2`) did not finish after ~15 minutes of continuous worker CPU time (441s and 170s accumulated CPU on the two workers, confirmed still actively importing, not hung) and was terminated to reclaim the session. Root cause is environment, not this change: the implementer's notes record that poetry install --sync fails outright on this Windows/py3.13 machine (pymssql 2.2.11 has no compatible wheel and needs a C toolchain), and the venv was repaired by pip-installing poetry.lock-pinned versions of ~10 packages without touching pyproject.toml/poetry.lock. Three packages could not be installed this way because they need native/Rust/C++ toolchains unavailable here: pyroscope-io, tree-sitter, tree-sitter-languages (pymssql itself did install, but as 2.4.2, not the pinned 2.2.11). pyroscope is imported at module load by several core modules (rest_api/middleware/pyroscope_middleware.py, configs/pyroscope_config.py, rest_api/handlers/assistant_handlers.py, workflows/workflow.py, datasource/base_datasource_processor.py, and others), so most of the app's import graph is reachable from a large fraction of the 1121 test files, which is consistent with collection alone being extremely heavy on this box. This gate is unverified, not passed, per the guide's own exit-codes-that-mislead policy. As a narrower, honestly-labeled substitute (NOT a replacement for the full gate): `poetry run pytest tests/codemie/rest_api/a2a/ -v` (the directory containing this slice's new/changed test) completed cleanly in 117.79s: 85 passed, 4 warnings, including both new tests in test_version.py. That result is real signal for the Slice 1 diff but does not stand in for the full `make test` gate the guide defines.
